response.query: Which proteomic readouts (phospho-proteomics, targeted phospho-flow panels) and sampling timepoints should we include to capture EGFR/PI3K/AKT signaling changes across genotypes?
response.answer: Include phospho-proteomics and targeted phospho-flow panels for EGFR/PI3K/AKT signaling. Sample at baseline, post-stimulation, and at key timepoints during treatment. Focus on early and late timepoints to capture dynamic changes.
